def ode(Y, t, params, cell_positions):
    p = params
    dY = np.zeros_like(Y)
    V, W = Y[:,0], Y[:,1]
    
    # 假設 get_voronoi_neighbors_wo_outer 已在主程式中定義
    neighbors = get_voronoi_neighbors_wo_outer(cell_positions)
    
    for i in range(Y.shape[0]):
        neibs = neighbors[i]
        laplacian_V = 0.0
        if neibs:
            sum_w = 0.0
            sum_Vw = 0.0
            for j, w in neibs.items():
                sum_Vw += V[j] * w
                sum_w += w
                
            if sum_w > 0:
                laplacian_V = (sum_Vw / sum_w) - V[i]
        


        noise = p['noise_level'] * (np.random.rand() - 0.5)
                
        # FitzHugh-Nagumo 方程
        dV = V[i] - (V[i]**3)/3 - W[i] + p['I_ext'] + p['D_v'] * laplacian_V + noise
        dW = p['epsilon'] * (V[i] + p['beta'] - p['gamma'] * W[i])
        
        dY[i,0] = dV
        dY[i,1] = dW
        
    return dY
